design_philosophy: A sophisticated, editorial take on Indian e-commerce. Avoids the standard 'Amazon/Flipkart' template. Uses high-contrast structural layouts (bento grids), crisp 1px borders, and vibrant culturally resonant accents (Indigo, Marigold) grounded on an organic, airy off-white canvas.
target_audience: Modern Indian shoppers looking for a premium yet approachable buying experience.

rules: Do NOT exceed text-6xl for main hero headings. Ensure mobile headings are scaled down gracefully.
Overlines (e.g., category labels) must be uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, and tracking-[0.2em].
Prices must use a slightly bolder weight and Indian number formatting (e.g. ₹1,29,999).

layouts.homepage: Bento-grid (Tetris style) for hero and featured categories to break the monotony of standard sliders. Use wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
layouts.plp_product_listing_page: High-density grid (grid-cols-2 mobile, grid-cols-4 desktop). Products must have crisp 1px borders instead of floating soft shadows. Use uniform aspect ratios for product images (e.g. aspect-[4/5] for fashion, aspect-square for electronics).
layouts.pdp_product_detail_page: Asymmetrical layout. Sticky left column for massive, high-res image gallery. Scrolling right column for product details, sticky 'Add to Cart' bar on mobile.
layouts.cart_checkout: Focus strictly on usability. One-column minimal layout on mobile, two-column on desktop. Suppress unnecessary navigation during checkout to minimize drop-off.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp slight curve (rounded-md). Solid high-contrast colors. Add 'hover:-translate-y-[2px]' and subtle shadow on hover.
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless approach where possible, or use flat surface with 1px border. No muddy drop shadows. On hover, darken border and add slight elevation.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to have rounded-md, ring-offset-background, focus:ring-primary. No native HTML inputs.
component_guidelines.badges: Used for 'Bestseller', 'X% Off'. Use vibrant accent color (Marigold/Saffron) with dark text for high visibility.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with 1px bottom border. Must include Logo, Search Bar, Account, Wishlist, Cart.

motion.hover: Instant visual feedback. Micro-transitions on color and transform (e.g. duration-200 ease-out).
motion.cart_interaction: When clicking 'Add to Cart', use a subtle pop animation or a toast notification from Sonner. Never interrupt user flow with a modal unless required.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially text_muted, passes APCA contrast checks against background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='add-to-cart-btn'`).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

hero_fashion.description: Vibrant fashion lifestyle model. Use for Hero Banner or Fashion Category.

category_electronics.description: Minimalist tech gadgets. Use for Electronics Category banner or featured tech.

category_beauty.description: Skincare product flatlay. Use for Beauty & Wellness Category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page or multi-view React application based on the requested features.
Use standard Lucide React icons for UI elements.
Format ALL currency using INR (₹) and Indian numbering system (e.g., ₹1,50,000).
Avoid generic Bootstrap-like layouts. Use structural grids with 1px borders for a premium, clean look.
Include dummy products across different categories to populate the PLP and Homepage.
Do not use generic blue/yellow clone colors. Stick to the refined color palette provided.
Create Shadcn components in 'src/components/ui' and modify them to fit the aesthetic.
For the 'Add to cart' flow, wire up a basic state context or mock it beautifully with toast notifications (Sonner).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it distinct and beautiful.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Add explicit transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Never use AI emoji characters for icons.
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12 where appropriate). Cramped designs look cheap.
Add 'data-testid' to all key interactive elements.
